text:
Maya: Kicking off slice deploy (slice: canary-7) in ~5m — aiming for 21:00 PT. Will do a quick bake + smoke and then roll.
Jordan: I can cover smoke + logs. Which quick checks do you want me to run? :+1:
Maya: Quick checklist: 1) /health -> 200 2) p50/p95 gen latency 3) 5xx/error-rate 4) redis/kv hit-rate 5) token cost surge. Keep logs for 15m.
Sasha: I'll run the scripted smoke and watch redis.

Sasha: Running script now:
```
./ops/smoke.sh --target canary-7 --suite quick
```

Liam: I'll monitor Prometheus and alert windows (p95, cpu, mem, 5xx-rate).
Maya: Manual curl if anyone wants a quick sanity check:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_TEST' -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"ping"}' | jq .
```

Jordan: ran the curl locally — health 200, latency p50 108ms, p95 290ms, errors 0 in last 1m :thumbsup:
Sasha: cache hit ~92% on canary-7, looks nominal.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy finished for canary-7 — pods 3/3 ready.
Maya: Rolling traffic to slice-2 now. Rollback criteria: CPU > 80% sustained for 5m OR p95 > 500ms OR 5xx rate > 0.5%.
Liam: Watchlist created in Ops dashboard: p95_latency, cpu_pct, mem_pct, http_5xx_rate, kv_error_rate.
Jordan: Manual rollback command for reference:
```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/redwood-serving --to-revision=42
```
(keep the revision handy, will update if different)
Sasha: Heads-up — I backported a small logging filter to reduce TRACE spam in canaries; shouldn't impact perf.
Maya: Ok hold for 10m after roll then we can close if all stable. Ping me immediately for any regressions.
Liam: Monitoring window open now (+0m). Setting 1m and 5m alerts.
Jordan: +6m check: p95 stable, cpu normal, error 0. I think we're good so far.
Maya: Thanks team. When you close, drop a one-line note here and add a short entry to the release thread (what we checked + duration).
